events.title: Alexios I Komnenos is crowned Byzantine emperor
events.description: Days after his troops took Constantinople from Nikephoros III, Alexios Komnenos was crowned emperor. His dynasty steadied Byzantium for a century, and his appeal to the Pope helped prompt the First Crusade.
events.html: Days after his troops took Constantinople from Nikephoros III, Alexios Komnenos was crowned emperor. His dynasty steadied Byzantium for a century, and his appeal to the Pope helped prompt the First Crusade.

events.title: US Congress fixes the flag at thirteen stripes
events.description: The Flag Act of 1818 set the American flag at thirteen stripes for the original colonies, with a star for every state added on the following 4 July. The rule still governs the flag today.
events.html: The Flag Act of 1818 set the American flag at thirteen stripes for the original colonies, with a star for every state added on the following 4 July. The rule still governs the flag today.

events.title: William Henry Harrison dies a month into his presidency
events.description: President William Henry Harrison died 31 days after taking office, the shortest presidency in US history. His death raised the first test of presidential succession, settled when John Tyler took full office.
events.html: President William Henry Harrison died 31 days after taking office, the shortest presidency in US history. His death raised the first test of presidential succession, settled when John Tyler took full office.

events.title: Lincoln walks through the fallen Confederate capital
events.description: Abraham Lincoln toured Richmond, Virginia, two days after its evacuation, greeted by crowds of newly freed Black residents. He sat briefly at Jefferson Davis's desk in the Confederate White House.

events.title: Twelve nations sign the North Atlantic Treaty
events.description: Foreign ministers meeting in Washington signed the treaty that created NATO, committing members to treat an attack on one as an attack on all. The alliance anchored Western defence through the Cold War.
events.html: Foreign ministers meeting in Washington signed the treaty that created NATO, committing members to treat an attack on one as an attack on all. The alliance anchored Western defence through the Cold War.

events.title: Martin Luther King Jr. is assassinated in Memphis
events.description: Martin Luther King Jr. was shot dead on the balcony of the Lorraine Motel, where he had come to support striking sanitation workers. Riots broke out in more than a hundred American cities.
events.html: Martin Luther King Jr. was shot dead on the balcony of the Lorraine Motel, where he had come to support striking sanitation workers. Riots broke out in more than a hundred American cities.

events.title: Bill Gates and Paul Allen found Microsoft
events.description: Gates and Allen formed a partnership in Albuquerque, New Mexico, to sell a BASIC interpreter for the Altair 8800. Their company went on to dominate personal computer software.
